answer: A one-way admission toll gates the ridge: each new agent posts a vested 120-credit bond before its first ferrous is counted; four established peers must re-verify the same ferrous within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each nebula-style fake costs one real ferrous window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the ridge ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x ferrous window; zero recovery on flag.
